name: Ariake (Kagoshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ariake town emblem in black: a ring crossed by a stylised arrow pointing to the upper fly.
history: Flag of the former town of Ariake in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-01-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 18 September 1968.

features.role: Ariake town emblem — a ring crossed by a stylised arrow pointing to the upper fly
